method.scope: 195-aa human apical surrogate only; mouse aligned apical domain only
method.join: sha256(actual extracted binder chain A sequence), no name join
method.alignment: global BLOSUM62, open -10, extension -0.5; retain all six optimal mappings
method.domain_fit: all 192 unambiguous apical CA pairs, proper Kabsch
method.local_fit: unambiguous CA pairs within 12 A of any human contact target CA; >=10 pairs
method.contacts: any heavy atom <=4.5 A; also raw 4.0/5.0 A sets; clashes strictly <2.0 A
method.backbone_clash: any binder heavy atom vs mouse target N,CA,C,O; no hydrogen atoms
method.chemistry: invariance across every optimal alignment, BLOSUM62, formal D/E=-1 K/R=+1; His unassigned
method.caveat: No docking, relaxation, protonation energy, KD, or binding prediction; static mouse AF rotamers
